name: My Mudra Fincorp Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2013, My Mudra Fincorp
Ltd provides services for loans, insurance 
and credit cards[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MMFL specializes in distribution and sales of a diverse range of Financial Products like Loans (secured & unsecured), Insurance and Credit Cards. Currently, the company has 9 owned branches and 154 franchisees in 15+ states. It is a Corporate DSA for 90+ banks and NBFCs in India

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 35.2%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 66.3 to 86.1 days.
